title: malaxis retusa
intro: Malaxis retusa, commonly known as the "Least Adder's-mouth," is a species of orchid native to Central and South America. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including its potential to aid in reducing inflammation and its antimicrobial properties, which may help in treating various infections. Malaxis retusa is also believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-proliferative and anti-inflammatory effects, which could be beneficial in treating certain types of cancer and inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Malaxis retusa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
